email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with a mild headache
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 34-year-old female patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their second dose of DemoZanix (dose: 5mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-02-19.
Approximately 5 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild headache.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
R. Haddad (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter726@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
